note: NSE trading holidays. ONLY fixed-date national holidays are seeded here, because they are the only ones that can be stated without a calendar: Republic Day, Independence Day and Gandhi Jayanti fall on the same date every year. The rest of the NSE list — Holi, Id, Ram Navami, Mahavir Jayanti, Good Friday, Buddha Purnima, Muharram, Ganesh Chaturthi, Dussehra, Diwali (with its Muhurat session), Guru Nanak Jayanti, Christmas — moves every year and is NOT included. Guessing those dates would be worse than leaving them out: a wrong date silences a real trading day, or lets alerts fire on a closed one. Copy the remaining dates from the NSE holiday circular each January and add them below.
